title: plan-scenes — scene list
description: Output of the plan-scenes planner: a JSON array of one scene per storyboard beat, in playback order (ONLY the array). Grading criteria: .claude/references/craft-bar/deliverable-plan-scenes.md.

name.description: Short scene label, carried from the storyboard beat.

method.description: The realization method from the palette, sensibly chosen for this beat — not one method applied to all.

brief.description: Self-contained: the timecode, the subject, the visual direction carried from the storyboard, the spoken VO line(s), and a duration.
